European Commission Executive Vice-President Dombrovskis said securing a just and lasting peace in Ukraine is a strategic priority for Europe and that the EU must continue to pressure Russia to end its aggression. After talks with EU foreign ministers on Ukraine's financing, he said priorities are clear: provide financial support, strengthen Ukraine's air-defence capabilities, and advance its EU accession process.
ZELENSKIY thanked European decision-makers for decisive measures and said Ukraine's fiscal resilience is essential to safeguarding shared European security.

Ukrainian President Zelenskiy thanked European Commission President Von der Leyen for her personal efforts to accelerate the disbursement of the funds, saying Ukraine's budget needs are rising ahead of winter as Russian attacks on energy, heating, water and other critical infrastructure intensify.
Zelenskiy said the European Commission and European Council approved the largest-ever single disbursement to Ukraine under the Ukraine Assistance Mechanism, nearly €8 billion.
